P4-M4 RF5: "exit all my lending positions" is read as exit-all (position custody, category lending); the solver asks the scope when a network could not be read, then lists every withdraw in a moves confirm.
P4-M4 RF5: "go 100% stablecoins on base" is a rebalance on the asset axis (any-stable 10 000 bps, scope Base); every computed swap is listed in a moves confirm.

P4-M4 RF12: "fund alice.eth with 25 usdc on base" is the payment "send 25 usdc to alice.eth on base" (rule abstract:fund); amount, token, network and recipient are copied as typed; equals the corpus plan.
P4-M4 RF5: "wrap 0.1 eth on base" is the 1:1 wrap step, read as the swap ETH -> WETH on Base (rule abstract:wrap); amount and network as typed.
P4-M4 RF12: the payment purpose "rent of" is consumed by rule abstract:paymentPurpose; the payment is read as typed and equals the corpus plan.
P4-M4 RF5: "make sure alice.eth gets exactly 50 usdc on arbitrum" is one exact transfer of the stated amount on Arbitrum (rule abstract:exactly); equals the corpus plan.
P4-M4 RF5: "close everything on base" is exit-all of the positions on Base; every withdraw is listed in a moves confirm.
P4-M4 RF5: "with the best provider" is a best-venue phrase: the solver ranks the staking provider (default chip); amount half of the SOL as before; equals the corpus plan.
P4-M4 RF5: "even out my usdc between base and arbitrum" is a network-axis rebalance 50/50; the one computed bridge is listed in a moves confirm and equals the corpus plan.
P4-M4 RF5: "withdraw all my usdc from everywhere" is exit-all of USDC positions on every network; unread networks are asked (SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS), never treated as empty.
P4-M4 RF5: "on the safest venue" is a best-venue phrase: the deposit of the USDC on Base goes to the ranked venue (default chip), as "put my usdc to work on base" reads; equals the corpus plan.
P4-M4 RF5: "get my sol ready for a payment of 50 usdc on solana" is a SOL -> 50 USDC exact-output swap on Solana (rule abstract:ensure); the SOL amount is priced (chip); equals the corpus plan shape.
